items.description: Job Description: Business Overview We are the development department that supports Rakuten Ichiba, Rakuten's founding business. Rakuten was founded in 1997, and Rakuten Ichiba has continued to embody Rakuten's mission of "empowering people and society through innovation." It has created a system that allows people with strong commercial skills to easily open stores beyond the limits of their physical business area, delivering the joy of shopping to users throughout Japan. Rakuten Ichiba service page: https://www.rakuten.co.jp/ 　 Department Overview Rakuten Ichiba is a marketplace where a diverse range of merchants from across Japan come together. This diversity is what makes Rakuten Ichiba attractive, and our section develops and provides the products that merchants need to operate more efficiently and grow on Rakuten Ichiba. Our section develops and provides solutions and external-integration platforms for merchants on Rakuten Ichiba and the vendors that support their operations. Mission Our mission is to support the growth of merchants on Rakuten Ichiba from two angles: by providing operational support solutions, and by providing external-integration platforms. We look across the entire ecosystem - not only merchants, but also the vendors that support their operations - and aim to maximize the value we deliver through multiple products. What Makes This Role Attractive The appeal of this role lies in being able to design the experience, user flow, and priorities across multiple products, beyond improvements to a single product. These products are used by merchants representing over 90% of Rakuten Ichiba's Gross Merchandise Sales (GMS), serving as a core foundation of the Rakuten Ichiba ecosystem. While collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and taking into account the challenges and growth phase of each merchant and external partner, you can take on product management that creates value across the entire product portfolio rather than through local optimization. The main services in our scope include BOSS, Compass, RMS Service Square, and platforms that enable external integrations. - BOSS: A Solution that supports merchants' day-to-day operations, including orders, inventory, and shipping - Compass: A Solution that supports merchants on Rakuten Ichiba in creating and updating their online shop pages - RMS Service Square: A Platform where merchants can discover, adopt, and use tools and services from external vendors - Platforms that enable external integrations: Platforms that connect merchant and vendor systems and services with Rakuten Ichiba 　 Position: Why We Hire As the challenges faced by merchants and vendors become increasingly sophisticated and diverse, we too must move beyond improving individual products and focus on how to combine multiple products to maximize value. In recent years, leveraging AI and other technologies has accelerated development speed, enabling us to execute a greater number of initiatives. At the same time, the importance of judging "what to build" and "why it should be prioritized" from a mid- to long-term perspective has grown significantly. For this reason, we are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can take an overarching view of the section's entire product portfolio and organize and drive its mission and vision, roadmap, KPIs, and development priorities across products. After joining, you will work closely with individual product managers and stakeholders across business and engineering to lead the formulation and execution of the mid- to long-term product strategy, roadmap, KPIs, and development priorities for the section as a whole. 　 Position Details Job Overview You will join as the Senior Product Manager for the section that owns the product portfolio for merchants on Rakuten Ichiba and the vendors that support their operations. You will take a cross-product view across multiple Solutions and Platforms, and lead the product strategy for the section as a whole. You will design the value proposition, target segments, positioning, product-to-product integrations, customer experience, KPIs, and development priorities to contribute to the business growth of merchants and vendors. Day-to-day management of individual products will be shared with each product manager, while you take ownership of the overall product outputs across the section. You will also support the product managers in the section so that they can think about What/Why at a higher level. Job Details - Defining the vision, mid- to long-term strategy, and roadmap for the section's entire product portfolio - Identifying product opportunities and setting priorities based on market trends, competitors, and the challenges faced by merchants and vendors - Designing how to maximize value by combining products such as BOSS, Compass, RMS Service Square, and products that enable external integrations - Driving alignment and decision-making with diverse stakeholders - Working with the product managers of individual products to ensure the quality and consistency of the section's product outputs Benefits and Attraction Through the Solutions and Platforms in our section, you can influence a broad area that supports the businesses of merchants and vendors on Rakuten Ichiba. By maximizing value through combinations of multiple products, you can directly contribute to merchants' operational efficiency and sales growth, vendors' business expansion, and the strengthening of the Rakuten Ichiba ecosystem as a whole. Beyond improvements to individual products, by leading product strategy, portfolio design, and roadmap planning across the section, you can gain the experience of creating significant business impact on a product portfolio that supports one of Japan's largest EC marketplaces. Stakeholders Merchants, vendors, development teams, product managers, project managers, sales, customer support, security team, business divisions, and other internal teams. 　 Work Environment You will join as a member of the section that delivers the product portfolio for merchants and vendors, and work in close collaboration with multiple product teams. For meetings with development teams, documentation, and day-to-day project communication, we mainly use English. For communication with merchants, vendors, and internal stakeholders, we use Japanese. 　 Mandatory Qualifications: - More than 5 years of product management experience in web services, SaaS, platforms, business support services, or EC-related services - Ability to analyze market environments, customer challenges, and competitive trends, and to identify product opportunities and issues from a customer perspective - Ability to envision the future needs of merchants and vendors and to draft a mid- to long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap that combine multiple products - Ability to engage stakeholders across different functions (customers, external partners, sales, support, development, security, etc.) and to lead alignment and decision-making - Business Level English proficiency - Business Level Japanese proficiency 　 Desired Qualifications: - Experience designing and driving a product portfolio, roadmap, and priorities across multiple products - Experience planning and operating platforms or integration features for external vendors, partner companies, or internal developers - Experience enhancing customer value through integrated experiences, user flows, or package design across multiple products - Experience improving products based on KPIs, user research, inquiry analysis, and feedback from sales and support - Experience contributing to the improvement of product management quality within a team through product reviews and knowledge sharing 　 Other Information: Additional information on Location Tokyo 　 Additional information on English Qualification TOEIC Score 800 above or possess equivalent abilities. items.description: Job Description: Department Overview The Ad Product Section (APS) division is a high-performance, global team distributed across Tokyo, Singapore, India, and China. We pride ourselves on being a hub of technical excellence, where motivated, diverse, and talented engineers collaborate to solve complex problems at scale. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our team and help us define the next generation of our advertising platform. This is not just a coding role; it is a position of architectural and technical cultural leadership. You will own the end-to-end product development lifecycle, leveraging a modern tech stack and AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-impact solutions. We are looking for a technologist who doesn't just keep up with the industry, but shapes it - someone who thrives on building scalable systems, mentoring the next generation of engineers, and integrating AI to push the boundaries of productivity and software quality. If you are a builder who values technical rigor, thrives in cross-functional environments, and is eager to contribute to Rakuten’s expansive global ecosystem, we want to talk to you. Position: Position Details 1) Project Execution & Engineering Excellence ・Technical Leadership: Translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable, and maintainable technical specifications and architectural designs. ・Lifecycle Ownership: Own the full SDLC - from initial design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and proactive maintenance across all environments. ・Quality Assurance: Conduct rigorous code reviews, ensuring adherence to design patterns, security best practices, and long-term maintainability. ・AI-Augmented Development: Drive engineering velocity by integrating AI-powered coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) into the team’s workflow. Establish standards for AI-assisted code generation, ensuring that AI-written code is rigorously vetted for security, accuracy, and alignment with system architecture. 2) Strategic Innovation & Productivity ・System Stewardship: Maintain a deep understanding of the product ecosystem to identify technical debt and architectural bottlenecks. Proactively propose and lead initiatives to refactor or enhance systems for better performance and scalability. ・AI-Driven Productivity: Leverage advanced prompt engineering to automate repetitive tasks - such as documentation generation, legacy code refactoring, and test suite creation - to maximize team bandwidth. ・Tech Radar: Stay ahead of the curve by evaluating emerging technologies and AI tools, creating strategic roadmaps to integrate innovations that provide a competitive advantage. 3) Collaboration & Cross-Functional Impact ・Partnership: Act as the primary technical bridge between Product, Design, and Engineering. Translate high-level business objectives into clear, actionable technical plans. ・Technical Advocacy: Influence product roadmaps by anticipating future technical constraints and opportunities, ensuring the platform remains resilient as business needs evolve. 4) Mentorship & Technical Culture ・Team Growth: Actively mentor junior engineers and interns. Foster a culture of technical excellence by providing constructive feedback, guiding career progression, and promoting best practices in software design. ・ Knowledge Sharing: Champion a culture of continuous learning, ensuring the team stays informed on modern development paradigms and AI-assisted workflows. Mandatory Qualifications: ・Experience & Impact: 6 or more years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex, large-scale web application projects from inception to production. ・Architectural Mastery: Deep hands-on expertise in Java (Spring Boot/Batch) and Cloud-native architectures (GCP ecosystem: BigQuery, DataProc, Composer). Ability to design for scale, performance, and high availability. ・Data Strategy: Strong proficiency in both relational (MariaDB/MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases, with the ability to choose the right data storage strategy for specific architectural needs. ・AI-Augmented Engineering ・Agentic AI: Demonstrated experience in designing or implementing Agentic AI workflows (e.g., using frameworks like LangChain, n8n, dify, or custom agent orchestration) to solve complex business problems. ・LLM Systems Architecture & Design: Expert in designing and deploying production-grade LLM applications. Proficient in end-to-end architectural strategy, including model selection, optimized RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration, tool integration, and rigorous evaluation frameworks to ensure performance and reliability. ・Developer Productivity: Expert-level fluency in AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to drive high-velocity development while maintaining rigorous security and quality gates. ・System Design ・Analyzing complex business systems, industry requirements and governance, and creating solution designs from them. ・Proven architecture and design experience for cloud-based platforms and enterprise applications including defining microservices boundaries, API design, and asynchronous communication patterns. ・Soft Skills & Ownership: A "get-things-done" mindset with demonstrated accountability for system health and team output. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present architectural decisions to mixed audiences including Senior Management, Product Management, and Engineers across disciplines. ・Product Thinking with Analytical Capabilities: Strategic Product Thinking with deep analytical abilities to transform complex business requirements into high-margin, AI-driven platform capabilities. Desired Qualifications: ・Big Data Ecosystem: Experience with Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Tez, or Presto. ・Database: Dimensional database (e.g. ClickHouse). ・Frontend Expertise: Proficiency in modern frameworks like React.js or Angular. ・Caching & Messaging: Experience with Redis, Couchbase, Cassandra, Kafka, or RabbitMQ. ・DevOps & Quality: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), Test Automation (JUnit), and Code Quality tooling (SonarQube). ・Domain Expertise: Prior experience in AdTech or high-traffic advertising system architectures is a significant plus. ・Data Visualization: Familiarity with BI tools (MicroStrategy, Tableau) for data-driven decision-making. ・AI-adoption: Experience evaluating and governing AI tool adoption across engineering teams. ・Languages & Frameworks: Java (Spring Boot/Batch), JavaScript/TypeScript (HTML5/CSS3). ・Data & Infrastructure: MariaDB/MySQL, MongoDB, GCP (BigQuery, DataProc, Composer). ・AI/Agent Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, n8n, ADK, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or equivalent. ・LLM Tooling: Prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, LLM observability (LangFuse or equivalent). ・AI Developer Tools: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot - fluent in AI-assisted engineering workflows. ・Tools & Process: Version Control (Git), Agile/Scrum, Task Management (Jira). #engineer #applicationsengineer #globaladdiv #RakutenAdvertising #Java In Japanese, Rakuten stands for ‘optimism.’ It means we believe in the future. Position: Position Details We're building agents that work inside Rakuten's commerce ecosystem - shopping assistants that understand what a customer actually wants and find it across a vast, messy, multi-merchant catalog; and merchant-facing agents that handle listing, pricing, and operations work that used to require a human in a dashboard. The distinguishing constraint of this role: these agents take real actions on real commerce state. They add to carts, apply coupons, initiate returns, update listings, trigger fulfillment. A hallucinated sentence is an inconvenience; a hallucinated order is an incident. You'll build the backend that makes agent actions safe, auditable, and reversible - while keeping them fast enough for a shopper who won't wait four seconds. ・Build the backend services behind conversational and autonomous commerce agents: intent understanding, multi-turn task execution, tool orchestration, human confirmation checkpoints ・Own the commerce tool layer - catalog search, product detail, inventory and price lookup, cart, checkout, order status, returns - exposing internal commerce APIs to agents with strict contracts, auth scoping, and blast-radius limits ・Solve grounding on a live catalog: retrieval over tens of millions of SKUs, attribute and variant normalization, freshness guarantees on price and stock, and preventing agents from confidently recommending things that don't exist or can't ship ・Design transactional safety for agent actions: idempotency, confirmation and rollback flows, spend and scope limits, permission models, and full audit trails for every action an agent takes on a user's or merchant's behalf ・Build evaluation and observability for commerce outcomes - task success, recommendation relevance, cart and conversion impact, containment and escalation rates - with tracing across multi-step runs and regression gates before release ・Optimize latency and unit economics: retrieval and tool-call budgets, model routing, prompt caching, cost per resolved task measured against the revenue or support cost it moves ・Work directly with commerce product, search/recsys, merchant platform, and trust & safety teams to ship agents through launch review into production Mandatory Qualifications: ・Over 5 years building and operating production backend services; strong in Python (Go or Java a plus) ・Experience developing ML-based production systems - search, recommendation, ads ranking, personalization, or fraud/risk. items.description: Job Description: Business Overview AI & Data Division (AIDD) spearheads data science & AI initiatives by leveraging data from Rakuten Group. We build a platform for large-scale field experimentations using cutting-edge technologies to provide critical insights that enable faster and better and faster contribution for our business. Our division boasts an international culture created by talented employees from around the world. Following the strategic vision “Rakuten as a data-driven membership company”, AIDD is expanding its data & AI related activities across multiple Rakuten Group companies. 　 Department Overview GPU Optimization Department (GPUOD) is responsible for the strategic management, optimization, and governance of Rakuten's company-wide AI infrastructure, ensuring high-performance, cost-efficient utilization of compute resources for machine learning workloads. We oversee a large-scale hybrid infrastructure spanning thousands of accelerators, including the latest Hopper and upcoming Blackwell architectures. As a central enabler for AI innovation, we: - Optimize compute resource allocation across on-premises and multi-cloud environments, maximizing efficiency for training and inference workloads. - Manage hybrid orchestration of diverse accelerator resources, ensuring seamless scalability and cost-effective deployment. - Develop and enhance frameworks for large-scale distributed training, with special focus on LLMs and generative AI. - Optimize inference performance through model optimization techniques and system-level acceleration. - Collaborate with internal teams to deliver scalable, high-availability inference services tailored to business needs. - Continuously evaluate next-generation hardware solutions, including specialized AI chips optimized for LLM workloads. - By effectively managing both conventional and specialized compute resources across on-premises and cloud environments, our team ensures Rakuten's AI ecosystem remains at the forefront of performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency. Position: Why We Hire - Work on cutting-edge LLM training & inference optimization at scale. - Directly impact Rakuten’s AI infrastructure by improving efficiency and reducing costs. - Collaborate with global AI/ML teams on high-impact challenges. - Opportunity to research and implement state-of-the-art GPU optimizations. 　 Position Details As a GPU Training & Inference Optimization Engineer, you will focus on maximizing the performance, efficiency, and scalability of LLM training and inference workloads on Rakuten’s GPU clusters. You will deeply optimize training frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, DeepSpeed, FSDP) and inference engines (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, SGLang), ensuring Rakuten’s AI models run at peak efficiency. This role requires strong expertise in GPU-accelerated ML frameworks, distributed training, and inference optimization, with a focus on reducing training time, improving GPU utilization, and minimizing inference latency. Key Responsibilities - Optimize LLM training frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, FSDP) to maximize GPU utilization and reduce training time. - Profile and optimize distributed training bottlenecks (e.g., NCCL issues, CUDA kernel efficiency, communication overhead). - Implement and tune inference optimizations (e.g., quantization, dynamic batching, KV caching) for low-latency, high-throughput LLM serving (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, SGLang). - Collaborate with infrastructure teams to improve GPU cluster scheduling, resource allocation, and fault tolerance for large-scale training jobs. - Strong knowledge of LLM inference optimizations (e.g., quantization, pruning, KV caching, continuous batching). - Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 　 Desired Qualifications: - items.description: Job Description: Business Overview Rakuten Group, Inc. is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses, and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content, and communications to approximately 1.7 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has nearly 32,000 employees and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/ Department Overview The AI & Data Division (AIDD) creates powerful, customer-focused search, recommendation, data science, advertising, marketing, price, and inventory optimization solutions to a variety of businesses in the Rakuten group. Our goal is to drive innovation by developing new products and capabilities that deliver significant impact over longer timeframes using AI. The LLMAD team drives adoption of Rakuten AI and open-source LLMs hosted within our own environment. We're hiring AI Engineers who can be embedded directly inside business units to drive real adoption of in-house large language models in place of third-party alternatives. Position: Position Details As a Senior AI Engineer you will own a business unit engagement end to end. You sit inside their engineering team and build with them: designing the agent, selecting and evaluating the model, writing the prompts and tool-use logic, and getting it live in production on our own infrastructure. You are expected to operate independently - taking a vague business ask, turning it into a concrete and evaluable LLM task, and being accountable for it shipping. What you build also becomes reusable: the cookbooks, recipes, and reference implementations the rest of the team and other business units start from. ・Own a business unit engagement end to end - embed in their engineering team, design the agent (task decomposition, tool and function calling, multi-step orchestration, state, retrieval, guardrails), and write production code in their codebase. ・Take agents from prototype to production and own what that requires: latency, cost, failure modes, and monitoring - including the judgment to say early when an agent is the wrong answer and a prompt, a fine-tune, or plain software is not. ・Select the right in-house or open-source model for each task and prove it with task-level evaluation rather than benchmark scores, building the eval sets and harnesses together with the business unit. ・Run migrations from third-party APIs to our in-house models - parity testing, prompt porting, staged cutover - and feed the gaps you find back to our model and platform teams. ・Own prompt and context engineering as a discipline: structured output, tool schemas, retrieval strategy, and caching, versioned and measured against evals; debug quality problems down to whether the fault is the prompt, the retrieval, the model, or the data. ・Turn the work into cookbooks, recipes, and reference implementations other business units can lift directly, and raise the bar around you through code review, mentorship, and hands-on enablement for business unit engineers. This role sits close to the product rather than close to the model: ・You will not be training or fine-tuning foundation models - that sits with our model research and training teams. ・You will not be building the LLM platform itself - that sits with our platform engineering teams. ・You will be embedded in a business unit, writing agent and integration code inside their product, and accountable for it shipping on our models. Mandatory Qualifications: ・Over 6 years of professional software engineering experience, with recent hands-on focus on building LLM applications. You are shipping this work today. ・Proven agentic engineering experience: you have built, shipped, evaluated, and debugged agents in production - tool and function calling, multi-step orchestration, and the failure modes that come with them. ・Prompt and context engineering as a discipline: structured outputs, systematic iteration against evals, and versioning. ・Practical model knowledge: the strengths and weaknesses of open-weight and commercial models, when to fine-tune versus prompt versus retrieve, and the cost and latency trade-offs of each. ・Solid production fundamentals: APIs, backend services, testing, observability, and experience with self-hosted or cloud inference (e.g., vLLM). ・Able to work embedded in someone else's engineering team, communicate directly with business stakeholders, and operate with the ambiguity of a function that is still being defined. ・Writes things down - docs, examples, and recipes other engineers can actually use. Desired Qualifications: ・Japanese language ability - a significant plus. Our business unit teams work in Japanese day to day, and being able to work in the language directly makes the embedded model far more effective. ・Experience migrating production applications from third-party LLM APIs to self-hosted or open-weight models. ・Retrieval-augmented generation at production scale. ・Exposure to fine-tuning or post-training, enough to know when to reach for it. ・Experience delivering with distributed teams in Japan or Asia. #engineer #applicationsengineer #aianddatadiv In Japanese, Rakuten stands for ‘optimism.’ It means we believe in the future. items.description: Job Description: Business Overview When you see the word "Rakuten", you probably have an image of many e-commerce-related services such as "Rakuten Ichiba", "Rakuten Books", and "Rakuten Fashion". If you order items from these services, it is commonplace every day that the items will be delivered to your home. So, where and how are these items managed, how are they boxed, shipped, and delivered to your home? In fact, these parts that you cannot directly see are the scope of responsibility of EC logistics, which we are in charge of. Department Overview We operate a number of warehouses in Japan where we store and manage Rakuten Books, Rakuten Fashion, and Rakuten Direct items, and perform tasks such as receiving and shipping. In addition, we have developed a service called "Rakuten Super Logistics" and receive items from merchants in Rakuten Ichiba, and we also do item-related work on behalf of them. What is necessary for the series of operations in this warehouse is the system developed by the EC Logistics Development Department. If our system stops, items purchased through e-commerce will not be delivered, and the only direct contact with customers is "logistics (delivery)". Logistics has a strong impression of being behind the scenes, but it plays such an important role. In addition, while managing these systems close to the "site (warehouse)", the control of the "estimated delivery date" displayed on Rakuten Ichiba, the "delivery status display" from the purchase history on Rakuten Ichiba, and the "delivery related notification" are also part of the system that our department is in charge of. In this way, we, the EC Logistics Development Department, develop and operate the "logistics" that support the Rakuten Group and the "systems" that support it in general. ECLD's Mission: 1. To realize a service that allows shoppers to get "what you want" "when you want it" and "where you want it" by utilizing logistics and IT. 2. To provide convenient logistics services and functions to shoppers so that they can enjoy shopping. 3. To support the operation of Rakuten Ichiba merchants from a logistics perspective and contribute to maximizing sales. 4. Contribute to the development of Rakuten Ichiba by expanding the above logistics system. 　 Position: Position Details We are looking for a product manager who is responsible for managing Logistics developments as one of technical organization in Rakuten Group and is able to communicate well with both business members and development members by demonstrating strong ownership and lead initiatives based on mid to long term business strategies in the Logistics domain. The product manager is responsible for creating the system roadmap, by aligning with stakeholders, supporting a series of system designing and development execution processes until its release. The position will also be responsible for KPI management for continuous product improvement to iterate PDCA cycles. Your main responsibilities will be as follows: - Develop a logically-sequenced product and feature roadmap. - Conduct product improvement activities and development management support. - Collaborate with business members such as those who are involved in the product you own. - Conduct system planning, system requirement definition, product design, and UI design according to business needs. - Support development cycles for the success of products based on defined KPIs. - Collaborate with developers such as engineers, designers, and infrastructure personnel. - Implement and provide support for services after system release. - Report to business owners about their products and project's progress and outcomes, in a way that can be evaluated with both numerical and/or non-numerical methods. The products you will be responsible for may depending on your experience and the status of ongoing projects, but the following are representative examples: - Warehouse Management System (WMS). - Shipping platform system that integrates with internal logistics systems and delivery carriers. - Logistics Platform system that integrates with external order management systems and warehouse systems. - Workforce Management System/KPI Management System (WFM). - Logistics service finance and accounting system. - Data management, analysis system tools (DWH, BI, etc.). 　 Work Environment We have approximately 160 members actively working both in Japan and overseas. Many of our members join with experience as product managers or engineers in software development industry. However, most of them do not originally have a background in logistics and acquire their industry knowledge after being assigned to our department. We primarily utilize the internal Private Cloud environment, with some resources on Public Cloud. Due to the nature of our logistics operations, we also maintain some on-premises environments for our warehouses. The department responsible for managing the network is also within the same development. Each member leverages their areas of expertise to contribute to the maintenance of these non-software domains as well. 　 Mandatory Qualifications: - 3 years or more of product management experience, or equivalent experience. - Experiences in collaborating with business members, engineers, test engineers, infrastructure personnel, designers, etc. to launch services. - Being able to analyze business requirements and make accurate input, such as system definition and system design with documents. - Being able to make decisions and make proposals using data. - Ability and passion to commit to a project. - Ability to communicate while involving stakeholders. - Ability to always consider maximizing customer satisfaction and decide on the action to be taken now. - Ability to respond to unexpected accidents and system troubles. - Business level Japanese proficiency. - TOEIC score of 800 or above or equivalent ability. Desired Qualifications: - Work experience as an IT engineer. - Product management experience for business systems. - Product management experiences in EC domain. - Agile development experience. - Data modeling and analysis experience using BI tools and big data. - Implementation of system tests, quality assurance tests, etc. - Experience in creating test scenarios. - Knowledge of the logistics industry. - Knowledge of Warehouse Management System (WMS). - Business level English proficiency. items.description: Job Description: Business Overview Rakuten Group, Inc. is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses, and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content, and communications to approximately 1.7 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has nearly 32,000 employees and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/ Department Overview The AI & Data Division (AIDD) creates powerful, customer-focused search, recommendation, data science, advertising, marketing, price, and inventory optimization solutions to a variety of businesses in the Rakuten group. Our goal is to drive innovation by developing new products and capabilities that deliver significant impact over longer timeframes using AI. The LLMAD team drives adoption of Rakuten AI and open-source LLMs hosted within our own environment. We're hiring AI Engineers who can be embedded directly inside business units to drive real adoption of in-house large language models in place of third-party alternatives. Position: Position Details As an AI Engineer you will be embedded inside a business unit's engineering team and build with them day to day: implementing agent workflows and integrations, iterating on prompts, running evaluations, and getting features live in production on our in-house models. You will work on an engagement alongside a senior engineer who sets the overall agent architecture and model direction, and you will take growing ownership of the delivery as you build depth. This is hands-on applied LLM work, close to the product. ・Embed inside a business unit's engineering team and implement agent and tool-use workflows for their use case - function calling, multi-step flows, retrieval, guardrails, and fallback handling - writing production code in their codebase. ・Get features from prototype into production and support them there: debugging failures, tightening latency and cost, and fixing what breaks. ・Run task-level evaluations of in-house and open-source models for your use case, and extend and maintain the eval sets and harnesses together with the business unit. ・Design and iterate prompts, output schemas, and tool definitions - versioned and measured against evals rather than tuned by feel - and help narrow quality problems down to the prompt, the retrieval, the model, or the data. ・Support migrations from third-party APIs to our in-house models, and surface the gaps you find to the senior engineer on the engagement and to our model and platform teams. ・Document what worked as reusable recipes, examples, and starter templates for the team's shared library, and help business unit engineers adopt our tools and APIs. Mandatory Qualifications: ・3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on work building LLM applications. ・Practical agentic engineering experience: you have built agents using tool and function calling or an orchestration framework and have debugged them when they misbehave. ・Working knowledge of prompt engineering: structured outputs, iteration against test cases, and the understanding that prompts need versioning and measurement. ・Strong fundamentals in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, Java, Go), and comfort with APIs, backend services, and testing. ・Curiosity about how models behave - you want to understand why an output was wrong, not just retry it. ・Comfortable working embedded in someone else's engineering team, communicating directly with business stakeholders, and operating with a degree of ambiguity. Desired Qualifications: ・Japanese language ability - a significant plus. Our business unit teams work in Japanese day to day, and being able to work in the language directly makes the embedded model far more effective. ・Retrieval-augmented generation experience. ・Familiarity with evaluation frameworks or LLM observability tooling. ・Exposure to self-hosted inference (e.g., vLLM) or cloud model deployment. #engineer #applicationsengineer #aianddatadiv In Japanese, Rakuten stands for ‘optimism.’ It means we believe in the future. Our mission is to empower people and society through the internet while aiming at becoming the Global Innovation Company. Rakuten’s technology organization has more than 2000 employees across Product Management, Research, Analytics, Product Development and Operations. Rakuten’s technical organization is responsible for building products that enable various business of Rakuten globally. Department Overview The Rakuten Search Department provides a powerful, customer-focused search engine to all the Rakuten Group services. This search engine is at confluence of supply and demand for each of the Rakuten Group businesses. Whenever a customer visits any Rakuten services and inputs in a query or browses through categories, our search engine is at work. Also, you will be able to work about latest digital advertising and Ad platform because we also closely work with outside Ad platformer as well. In the platform team, we have positions who have comprehensive knowledge of the platforms and provide total solution for business requirement by combining of multiple platform components. Our team develops and operates an ad serving platform that is widely used in Rakuten's overall services, including Rakuten Ichiba. The system consists of servers that respond to high traffic, such as tens of thousands of QPS, with low latency of less than 100ms, a backend system that processes huge log data of tens of billions of data per month, and campaign management UI. Position: Why We Hire With the practical adoption of AI, decision-making in ad serving is becoming faster and more sophisticated, and competition among platforms is intensifying. In addition, RUNA’s adoption within the Rakuten Group continues to expand, and as the scale of delivery and the diversity of use cases grow, we need to enhance model generalization, experiment velocity (A/B testing), and operational reliability. To address these external changes and rising internal demand, we are seeking data scientists who can drive initiatives end to end—from hypothesis formulation and modeling to online deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. Position Details - Problem definition for ad delivery optimization and the design of KPIs/metrics, along with observability (dashboards and alerts). - Data preprocessing, feature engineering, modeling, and offline evaluation (including simulation) for price optimization, CTR/CVR and value prediction, and creative optimization. - Online deployment and experiment design: A/B tests/bandits, calibration, rollout strategy planning, effectiveness evaluation, and continuous improvement. - Production operations and MLOps: building training/inference pipelines; monitoring and drift detection; model updates and automated rollback; quality and privacy governance. - Collaboration with internal stakeholders (product, engineering, sales/operations) on requirements definition, decision support, documentation, and knowledge sharing. items.description: Job Description: Business Overview Rakuten Group, under the mission of "Empowering People and Society through Innovation," operates a wide range of businesses both domestically and internationally, including e-commerce, travel, digital content, telecommunications, FinTech, and professional sports. 　 Department Overview The Business Support Development Department (BSD) is a development organization that supports the diverse business operations and systems of the Rakuten Group through the power of products, AI, and data. It optimizes complex business processes and provides the foundation that supports business growth. Within BSD, our team is a product development organization specializing in the DX of the Customer Support (CS) domain. Our mission is to improve customer experience, service quality, and operational productivity - achieved through the planning, development, and continuous improvement of products serving end users, merchant partners, and internal CS operators. Our product portfolio includes an inquiry management tool, an AI-powered response assist chat tool, and an inquiry analytics dashboard. We work with massive datasets and complex operational workflows, leveraging technology to fundamentally evolve how customer support is delivered at Rakuten scale. Position: Why We Hire Large-scale services such as Rakuten Ichiba and Rakuten Travel demand ever-higher standards of quality, speed, and productivity in customer support. Alongside improving inquiry handling, increasing self-resolution rates, and boosting operator efficiency, delivering new support experiences powered by generative AI has become a critical organizational priority. Against this backdrop, we are growing our engineering team to accelerate both ongoing product improvements and the development of new AI-driven features. We are looking for engineers who can take technical ownership of CS products, collaborate closely with product and operations, and help us ship impactful solutions at scale. Position: Position Details Software Engineer responsible for the design, development, and operation of customer support products. You will work closely with Product Managers, QA engineers, and CS stakeholders to build reliable, scalable systems that serve operators and end users alike. As a core member of a cross-functional team, you will contribute to the technical quality and continuous improvement of our CS product suite - from AI-powered chat tools to real-time analytics platforms. Responsibilities 1) Product Development - Design, develop, test, and operate CS products serving operators, merchants, and end users - Build and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices powering inquiry management, AI assist, and analytics systems - Develop responsive frontend interfaces using React, Redux Toolkit, and Next.js - Ensure high code quality through thorough code reviews, testing, and engineering best practices 2) Technical Collaboration - Work with Product Managers to translate business requirements into implementable technical specifications - Collaborate with QA engineers to define test strategies and ensure release quality - Participate in architecture and design reviews, contributing perspectives on usability and operational feasibility - Share updates and surface blockers through daily standups, chat, and team meetings 3) AI & Innovation - Participate in the planning, evaluation, and integration of generative AI, ML, and NLP-powered features into CS products - Actively leverage generative AI tools to improve development productivity and code quality - Explore and champion new technologies that deliver value to the team and its users 4) Continuous Improvement - Monitor production systems, identify bottlenecks, and drive performance improvements - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements for reliable and efficient deployments - Engage in post-release KPI monitoring and iterate based on data and user feedback Mandatory Qualifications: - Looking ahead, Rakuten envisions creating a new business model that leverages the assets we have cultivated online, such as "Rakuten Members", "Rakuten Points", "Brand Power", "Member Data", “Payment” and "Rakuten Mobile". By maximizing these assets, we aim to establish a more robust "Rakuten Ecosystem" that encompasses offline aspects of daily life as well. 　 Department Overview The business model of Rakuten Ichiba is BtoBtoC, and Client Stores, Society and Rakuten Group work together as a unity. Rakuten is an EC company that owns Japan's largest platform called Rakuten Ichiba. Rakuten Group's EC First Party Development Department (ECFD) cooperate and enlarge on the Rakuten Ichiba Platform. ECFD has several B-to-C businesses that will drive Rakuten business. The following services are currently operated by ECFD. ・Rakuten Fashion ・Rakuten 24, Rakuten 24 Express ・Rakuten Mart, Rakuten Zenkoku Super ・Rakuten Bic In the development of ECFD, we keep our eyes on the services along with the business, and we propose, develop, and verify the effectiveness of the services and systems from user experiences to operation management. You can acquire specialized and professional engineering skills related to e-commerce and the domain expertise of each industry. Position: Why We Hire In recent years, our services have experienced substantial annual growth. We are currently undertaking numerous projects aimed at improving and enhancing our offerings, necessitating the addition of new team members to help shape our future products. Furthermore, we are leveraging groundbreaking innovations in global IT system fundamentals, including automation, AI integration, advanced database models, and data transfer protocols, to drive our business forward. 　 Position Details We are on the lookout for competent and motivated Senior Product Manager to pioneer the evolution of retail industry systems based on the principle of product manager, which is Define and design products and services that delight customers and add strategic value to the company. As a Service Owner, successful candidates will strive to deliver the highest value to customers and partners with passion and a clear vision. items.description: Job Description: Business Overview Rakuten Group, Inc. is an innovative internet service company based in Japan. About 100 million customers in Japan and 1 billion customers globally use its services. Rakuten offers over 70 services in many areas. These include e-commerce, payment services, financial services, telecommunications, media, and sports. It is building the "Rakuten Ecosystem" to make people's lives and society better. Rakuten aims to give customers the best services and entertainment. It also wants to use technology to help its businesses grow. 　 Department Overview The EC Business Data Analytics & Platform Section is part of the Business Support Development Department (BSD) within the Commerce & Marketing Company. It develops and operates a data platform that uses the large amount of data from Rakuten Ichiba, which is a main business of Rakuten Group. This section provides the following main services and functions to speed up Rakuten Ichiba's business growth using data and AI.  It designs, builds, and operates a data warehouse (DWH) that brings together and stores many kinds of Rakuten Ichiba data. This provides a strong and scalable data base.  It develops and operates data pipelines for real-time and batch processing. This makes data collection, processing, and connection automatic, providing a steady data supply.  It develops data analysis, visualization, and reporting functions. This helps business intelligence (BI) and provides solutions that support fast and accurate decisions based on data.  It uses machine learning and AI technology to develop and operate new AI solutions. These include predictive analysis, automation, customer behavior analysis, and AI agents, which create new business value. For this position, we are seeking someone who, as a manager, will oversee the entire development team (including DEV/PJM/PDM) in one of the system areas mentioned above. This person will also be responsible for creating and carrying out technical strategies, and ensuring the quality, cost, and delivery of products and projects in their assigned area. 　 Position Details As an Engineering Manager, you will perform the following tasks, focusing on development in a specific area among data platforms, data warehouses, data pipelines, data solutions, and AI solutions: - Manage the entire engineering team, including DEV/PJM (Project Manager)/PDM (Product Manager). items.description: Job Description: Business Overview Rakuten is a leading Japanese e-commerce and internet services company that offers a wide range of products and services to customers worldwide. With a strong focus on innovation, Rakuten aims to empower individuals, businesses, and society as a whole through its unique ecosystem of e-commerce, fintech, digital content, and communications services. Department Overview The Merchandising and Advertisement Department leverages AI-driven advertisement optimization, and pricing and inventory optimization systems based on demand forecasting. By closely integrating the information obtained from merchandising into our advertisement strategies, we maximize the synergy between both functions. This enables us to efficiently deliver optimal offers and information to our customers, thereby contributing to increased sales and enhanced customer satisfaction. The Advertisement Optimization Group is a team of specialists in ad optimization, with AI at its core. We are responsible for the development and operation of highly effective ad optimization logic and platforms. Our mission is to maximize publishers' ad revenue while maintaining and improving advertisers' ROAS (Return On Ad Spend). Specifically, we continuously improve ad delivery optimization, bidding/budget allocation, personalization, and performance measurement, contributing to the realization of a world that enhances both advertisers' ROI (Return On Investment) and user experience. meta.title: QA Lead Engineer - Warehouse Management Section, EC Logistics Development Department (ECLD)

items.description: Job Description: Business Overview When you see the word "Rakuten", you probably have an image of many e-commerce-related services such as "Rakuten Ichiba", "Rakuten Books", and "Rakuten Fashion". If you order items from these services, it is commonplace every day that the items will be delivered to your home. So, where and how are these items managed, how are they boxed, shipped, and delivered to your home? In fact, these parts that you cannot directly see are the scope of responsibility of EC logistics, which we are in charge of. Department Overview We operate a number of warehouses in Japan where we store and manage Rakuten Books, Rakuten Fashion, and Rakuten Direct items, and perform tasks such as receiving and shipping. In addition, we have developed a service called "Rakuten Super Logistics" and receive items from merchants in Rakuten Ichiba, and we also do item-related work on behalf of them. What is necessary for the series of operations in this warehouse is the system developed by the EC Logistics Development Department. If our system stops, items purchased through e-commerce will not be delivered, and the only direct contact with customers is "logistics (delivery)". Logistics has a strong impression of being behind the scenes, but it plays such an important role. In addition, while managing these systems close to the "site (warehouse)", the control of the "estimated delivery date" displayed on Rakuten Ichiba, the "delivery status display" from the purchase history on Rakuten Ichiba, and the "delivery related notification" are also part of the system that our department is in charge of. In this way, we, the EC Logistics Development Department, develop and operate the "logistics" that support the Rakuten Group and the "systems" that support it in general. 1. To realize a service that allows shoppers to get "what you want" "when you want it" and "where you want it" by utilizing logistics and IT. 2. To provide convenient logistics services and functions to shoppers so that they can enjoy shopping. 3. To support the operation of Rakuten Ichiba merchants from a logistics perspective and contribute to maximizing sales. 4. Contribute to the development of Rakuten Ichiba by expanding the above logistics system. Position: Position Details In the operation of warehouses managed by JP Rakuten Logistics, Inc., a joint venture between Rakuten Group and Japan, and in the coordination of logistics-related data with Rakuten Ichiba, you will be required to plan, design, and implement the necessary quality assurance processes, and strive to improve the quality of the entire service, not just individual products. - As a QA Lead, actively participate in projects and be responsible for everything from planning QA implementation to execution and reporting. - Improve testing processes and promote required standardization. - Take the initiative in coordinating and negotiating with other companies, other departments within the company, and offsite with whom we have cooperative relationships, and strive to provide better outputs quickly. - Review and provide feedback on test specifications and test cases. - Cultivate future leader candidates through education to improve the overall productivity of the team. 　 Work Environment We have approximately 160 members actively working both in Japan and overseas. Many of our members join with experience as product managers or engineers in software development industry. However, most of them do not originally have a background in logistics and acquire their industry knowledge after being assigned to our department. We primarily utilize the internal Private Cloud environment, with some resources on Public Cloud. Due to the nature of our logistics operations, we also maintain some on-premises environments for our warehouses. The department responsible for managing the network is also within the same development. Each member leverages their areas of expertise to contribute to the maintenance of these non-software domains as well. Desired Qualifications: - Knowledge of the logistics industry. - Knowledge of Warehouse Management System (WMS). - Software development experience. - Experience in providing E-Commerce services (B2C, C2C, B2B2C). - Business level English proficiency. items.description: Job Description: Department Overview The Beauty Product Group develops "Rakuten BEAUTY" (https://beauty.rakuten.co.jp/ (opens in a new tab)), a search and booking service for beauty salons such as hair salons, aesthetic salons, and relaxation salons. In addition to Rakuten BEAUTY, the Leisure Product Department is responsible for multiple products designed to enrich and make users' lifestyles more enjoyable, including Rakuten GORA and Rakuten Keiba. Rakuten BEAUTY is an online booking service for beauty salons, including hair salons, aesthetic salons, and nail salons. The beauty and wellness needs of users continue to evolve and expand. We constantly monitor market trends and explore new business opportunities. However, we are currently still in the position of a challenger in the online beauty industry. While we aim to close the existing "gap," we are also exploring originality to become the industry leader. We develop our products with the belief that it's crucial to remain a challenger that impacts the industry. Position: Why We Hire "Rakuten BEAUTY" is not yet the number one service in the industry. As a challenger, we strongly embrace a spirit of challenge and believe that our growth will revitalize the beauty industry. We are looking for a Product Manager who shares this vision and will help grow the service and lead its products. We welcome applications from individuals who have a clear vision and passion for the kind of products they want to create in the future, those who wish to provide new value and experiences to users and society through our services, and those who aspire to further step up from a Project Manager or Project Leader role. 　 Position Details As a Product Manager for Rakuten Beauty, you will be responsible for product building and execution (project management) to provide new experiences to users and solve various problems they currently face. Your scope of work will encompass all stages involved in this product, from concept creation - addressing questions like "What should this product fundamentally be?" and "What do users truly want?" - to actual development and release, in close collaboration with engineers and QA. The products span a wide range, including a user-facing web frontend, mobile applications, and systems for salons. You will have the opportunity to create more valuable products for both users and salons, aiming to build products that impact the beauty industry. Specific Job Examples Future industry forecasting and analysis. Competitor analysis and product goal definition. Product KPI setting. Roadmap creation (short-term to long-term). Requirements definition. Task identification, management, and overall schedule management. Bug triage. Release judgment. 　 Work Environment We are a highly vibrant, multinational team composed of members from 10 different countries. It's a place where teamwork is highly valued, and interaction among members is very active. Regarding work-life balance, our team embraces a culture of "working efficiently," and we have working mothers and fathers among us. Many employees here are inclined to switch effectively between work and private life, aiming to enrich both their professional and personal lives. This role requires someone who can bridge the gap between engineering, product, and business stakeholders while contributing to backend development initiatives from early planning stages through implementation and deployment. Our development team is a global hybrid, with members based at HQ in Japan and in China. We are responsible for multiple systems, including the storefront, order management, and inventory management, with teams dedicated to each area. Prior experience managing a team or leading projects is highly valued. 　 Position Details Primary Responsibilities - Participate in backend development projects from early planning and requirement definition through implementation and deployment - Write technical specifications and design documents following team guidelines - Designing and developing system components with clear responsibilities, considering overall system integrity. - Conduct code reviews and mentor team members when needed - Present technical proposals and progress reports to both technical and non-technical stakeholders - Take ownership of complex features and drive technical initiatives that improve team productivity What Makes This Role Unique - Leadership Opportunity: Opportunity to lead technical initiatives and mentor team members - Business Impact: Direct influence on product direction through stakeholder engagement - Tech Stack: Java21, Spring Boot 3, Spring Web MVC/Batch, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Spanner, Redis, Apache Kafka - Production Scale: High-traffic e-commerce platform serving millions of users - End-to-End Ownership: Involvement from early requirement gathering and technical planning to production deployment - Cross-Cultural Environment: Work with global teams across Japan and China - meta.title: Product Manager (GORA) - Leisure Product Department (LPD)

items.description: Job Description: Department Overview The Golf Product Management Group is one of the teams within the Leisure Product Department, and is developing the "Rakuten GORA" service for golfers (https://gora.golf.rakuten.co.jp/). In addition to Rakuten GORA, the Leisure Product Department is responsible for several products that enrich and make users' lifestyles more enjoyable, such as Rakuten Beauty and Rakuten Horse Racing. Rakuten GORA is the No.1 website in Japan for golf course reservations, with approximately 1,900 golf courses affiliated with the site across Japan. In addition to domestic services, the company is expanding overseas, with outbound services in Hawaii, Guam, Saipan, Thailand and Vietnam, and inbound services in China and Korea (as of May 2025). The company has also launched a membership service for golfers, and plans to continue to provide new services that go beyond the scope of golf course reservations, while expanding its service area. In the process of enjoying golf, users experience various "inconveniences". They may not know which golf course to book, not have any golfing buddies to go with, have a hard time coordinating events, face high hurdles when wanting to start golfing, or struggle to improve even after practicing. We develop products every day with the desire to improve this industry which still retains old customs, provide new value and experiences to users, increase the number of people who enjoy golf through our services, and liven up the industry. Position: Why We Hire The product managers in our department are mainly made up of new graduates. As the number of users increases and their needs become more diverse, we want to hire people with a variety of experiences and skills to bring new perspectives to the team. We welcome applications from people who have a clear vision and passion for what kind of products they want to create in the future, people who want to provide new value and experiences to users and the world through their services, and people who want to step up from project manager/project leader. 　 Position Details As a product manager at Rakuten GORA, you will be responsible for product construction and execution (project management) to provide users with new experiences and solve various problems that users currently face. You will create concepts such as "What should this product be like in the first place?" and "What do users really want?", and work with engineers and QA to cover all processes related to this product from actual development to release. This position is characterized by the fact that there are many opportunities to create new products from scratch, not just improve existing products. You will be involved in building impactful products that can change the industry. Specific work examples - Future industry forecasting and analysis - Competitor analysis and product goal definition - Product KPI setting - Roadmap creation (short to long term) - Requirements definition - Task identification and management, overall schedule management - Bug triage - Release judgment 　 Work Environment It is a very lively team with many young members in their late 20s to early 30s. There are no boundaries between job titles or services in charge, and the entire department has an open atmosphere. We are very active in holding exchanges with other groups, such as information sharing sessions and problem solving. We also hold many events, such as drinking parties, bowling tournaments, and golf competitions, and there are opportunities to meet colleagues beyond work. Regarding work-life balance, our team has a culture of "working efficiently", and some employees are working mothers and fathers who go home on time every day. Many employees are motivated to switch on and off between work and private life efficiently and have a fulfilling private life and work life. Interview articles with team members: https://commerce-engineer.rakuten.careers/entry/workstyle/0043 Mandatory Qualifications: - Experience in upstream processes (requirements definition and above) in system development. - Experience in project management as a PM or PL. - TOEIC Score 800 above or possess equivalent abilities. *If you do not have a score, you can take the test for free during the selection process. Desired Qualifications: - Experience in market trend analysis. - Experience in system development (regardless of language). - Experience in building native app products. - Experience in user research and UI/UX improvements based on the research. - Experience in building product strategies. - Interest in the sports industry. Other Information: Additional information on English Qualification English (Comprehensive-1-Beginner), Japanese (Comprehensive-4-Fluent) Additional Message from Hiring Manager 　 Rakuten GORA is a service with the largest number of users in Japan. Therefore, we receive feedback from many users and realize every day that there are many problems. We would like to solve these problems by developing our service and building products that allow users to feel more fulfilled while spending their leisure time. The value we can provide is diverse, including "products that make golf more enjoyable", "products that create an environment where you can concentrate on golf", and "products that allow you to meet many golf friends". If you have a desire to launch a new service or want to collect user feedback at a more upstream stage and reflect it in the UI, this is a position where you can feel very rewarded and grow. In addition, more than past experiences, we are looking for people who are passionate about what kind of products they want to create in the future. If you want to change the industry with us, please apply. #engineer #productmanager #UX #commerce #RakutenGORA In Japanese, Rakuten stands for ‘optimism.’ It means we believe in the future. items.description: Job Description: Department Overview The Commerce & Marketing Technology Division is responsible for product management, development, and operations for various products including "Rakuten Ichiba" (our founding business), "Rakuten Fashion," "Rakuten Travel," "Rakuten GORA," and many others. You will drive sustained product growth by engaging in discussions with product planning and creative departments (marketers and designers) about product improvements and promoting product development. Position: Why We Hire As Rakuten Group continues to expand into new businesses and accelerate growth through synergy effects, Rakuten Ichiba, as the core of the Rakuten Ecosystem, has taken on an increasingly important role. With the diversification of lifestyles and recent environmental changes, more people are shopping online. We are seeking to strengthen our personnel structure to provide stronger support to merchants and are looking for new ideas that are not bound by traditional approaches. Position Details As a Product Manager for assigned products and features, you will: Clarify business and system requirements based on proposals from business units and create product specifications Identify improvement points based on various KPIs and feedback from users/clients, and create product specifications Create improvement roadmaps for assigned products and manage backlogs Communicate with a wide range of stakeholders to align understanding and drive projects forward Through this role, Product Managers are expected to showcase: Leadership skills to lead product improvements Ability to work with long-term plans in mind rather than focusing only on immediate concerns Ability to understand matters from a user perspective Critical thinking to identify the essence of matters Communication skills to coordinate with numerous stakeholders Ability to engage in healthy discussions within the team and advance matters without compromise This position offers the opportunity to develop various business skills including those mentioned above. Mandatory Qualifications: Communication skills to align understanding with various stakeholders Ability to overcome difficulties independently and achieve objectives Critical thinking to thoroughly analyze matters to their essence Integrity to persistently pursue improvements toward long-term goals Experience in requirements definition (3+ years, not limited to internet services) Desired Qualifications: Experience in product management for internet services Experience in analyzing product KPIs, implementing improvement measures, and growing products Experience in maximizing user experience Knowledge and experience as an engineer in internet services Knowledge and experience in project management Additional information on English Qualification In principle, a TOEIC score of 800 or above (or proof of equivalent English proficiency, or degree certificate from a university in an English-speaking country) If you do not have a score or certificate, we will guide you to take our company-sponsored TOEIC IP test during the selection process. #product #pdm #consultingsales #commerce #RakutenIchiba Languages: Japanese (Overall - 4 - Fluent) In Japanese, Rakuten stands for ‘optimism.’ It means we believe in the future. It’s an understanding that, with the right mind-set, we can make the future better by what we do today. So we challenge ourselves to evolve, innovate and experiment, to create a better, brighter future for everyone. Today, our 70+ businesses span e-commerce, digital content, communications and fintech, bringing the joy of discovery to almost 1.3 billion members across the world. If you have any trouble logging in, please contact us here Rakuten Group, Inc.: rakuten-recruiting-info@mail.rakuten.com *Please read the Application Requirements(EN) / 募集要項(JP) before applying. meta.title: Search Service Engineer, Booking Services Search Group - Search Department (SED)

items.description: Job Description: Business Overview Rakuten is one of the biggest marketplaces of Japan and is the largest internet ecosystem with a wide range of services ranging from e-commerce, Travel, Banking, Fintech, Food Delivery, Golf, Insurance, Instant Messaging, Mobile Network etc. Rakuten has over 140 services globally. Our mission is to empower people and society through the internet while aiming at becoming the Global Innovation Company. Department Overview The Search Department is part of the AI Engineering Supervisory Department under the AI & Data Division in Rakuten. Search Department focuses on Search, Discovery, and Navigation experience for users of Rakuten. We in the Search Department help demand meet supply through our services that are engineered for scale, performance, and ease of use. We support 20 plus Rakuten Businesses across three different continents, 50 plus user functions and over a billion active users annually generating over two billion dollars in revenue directly from us. Search Service Reliability & Engineering Group is responsible for delivering some of the Mission critical Rakuten Applications used by millions of users. Position: Why We Hire We are responsible for deploying and maintaining a distributed Search platform that empowers some of the biggest e-commerce and online travel agencies of Japan and enables Rakuten ecosystem services worldwide. Rakuten Search group is constantly striving to challenge what existing search technologies can do and going beyond. We are looking for a highly motivated software service engineers with commitment to customer satisfaction and a strong desire to create highest-quality Search platform for Rakuten Services. Position Details Responsibilities (includes but are not limited to) - Responsible for the delivery of search services to our customers. Master the inhouse search platform and customize to meet their business requirements, both functional and non-functional. - Collaborate with customers, product managers, backend software engineers, the quality assurance teams and service reliability engineers to identify requirements and develop comprehensive solutions. - Report defects of existing services and assist peers in triaging then resolving the issues. - Drive continuous improvement in our processes through innovation and collaboration, leveraging automation and data-driven insights to enhance service quality and reliability. - Review and occasionally write code to support your duty. Run end-to-end review of services deployment setup before production releases. Support in troubleshooting production issues. Mandatory Qualifications: - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field. - Good knowledge of programming, preferably Java and/or Python. - 5+ years of experience in Software Service Engineer and/or Software development, with proven recording of bringing new services to production. - Experience in some search engine software, like Solr and Elastic, with good understanding lexical search in multiple languages. - Experience with CI/CD tools (like Jenkins), integrating test automation seamlessly into continuous integration and deployment pipelines. Desired Qualifications: - Experience in performance testing methodologies such as Gatling, Locust or K6. - Exposure to modern search approaches, including LTR and Semantic Search. - Experience of search in e-commerce and Travel context. - Experience in custom support and troubleshooting. - Experience communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization. #engineer #applicationsengineer #aianddatadiv In Japanese, Rakuten stands for ‘optimism.’ It means we believe in the future. It’s an understanding that, with the right mind-set, we can make the future better by what we do today. So we challenge ourselves to evolve, innovate and experiment, to create a better, brighter future for everyone. Today, our 70+ businesses span e-commerce, digital content, communications and fintech, bringing the joy of discovery to almost 1.3 billion members across the world.
